steps.action: The frontend leave client submits a leave request to the main service.
The authenticated /v2/leaves route dispatches POST requests to leave.Creation.
The router binds the request representation and delegates to LeaveService.Creation.
The service loads the current identity and project, applies project, attachment, office and probation checks, and chooses a category/type implementation.
The bridge calculation creates dated details, consumes balances by year and persists leave-related records in a transaction.
Approval records and asynchronous approval notifications are created for the next approver.
The approve route binds the leave identifier and approver description.
The service rejects already completed approval records and permits the current approver, HR or administrators according to inline checks.
A database transaction updates the current approval record and advances the leave to the next approval state or the approved state.
The implementation creates the next level approval record when another level is required.
The service starts asynchronous notifications for the applicant and the next approver.
The API exposes cancellation application and direct cancellation handlers in addition to rejection.
The service selects a cancellation path from the current leave state and current identity.
The recovery implementation opens a database transaction and reconstructs balance restoration from leave details and year sources.
The transaction updates approval and leave states after restoring the affected holiday balances.
Notification composites are executed asynchronously after they are built inside the business path.

traces.title: Leave rejection and cancellation recovery flow

steps.action: Leave requests can carry uploaded file references and use the platform upload/download capability.
Approval, rejection and cancellation paths build email and mobile notification composites.
The export path queries leave records and creates a workbook with employee, project, type, date, hours, balance and status fields.
The simple leave interval endpoint supplies a reduced representation for adjacent worklog and management calculations.
The legacy service still schedules leave completion, holiday initialization and leave mail work.
